correctness.rationale: Every local automorphism is bijective and center preserving; every invertible center-preserving block map is local by a constructive symplectic witness for each noncentral vector and a multiplier witness for central vectors, valid in all characteristics. Ordinary automorphisms require GSp multiplier compatibility. The GL/Sp group-order ratio is exact and equals one only for q=2,m=1. Independent exhaustive 20195 linear maps over F2,F3 verify orbit-by-orbit, plus direct GL4(2)/Sp4(2) enumeration and 12 integer order identities. No numerical extrapolation is used.

It demonstrates that the complex result guaranteeing proper local automorphisms cannot be transported unmodified to arbitrary characteristic and precisely determines when the failure disappears as field size or symplectic rank increases. The whole infinite-field/rank phase diagram and exact group-order comparison answer a motivated mathematical boundary, not an arbitrary small enumeration.
